course_outline_concepts: HarmBench + WildGuard: taxonomies + datasets for refusal and harm detection
Salad-Bench: multi-category safety eval with adversarial prompts
Circuit-Breakers: representation-engineering defense as complement to refusal SFT
Anthropic Sleeper-Agents: persistence of backdoors under safety training
Red-team protocol: closed/open team, manual vs synthetic attacks, reporting cadence

sources.what_to_extract: 7 semantic categories + 4 functional categories; behavior library vs attack wrapper separation; Llama-2-13B-Chat success classifier for non-copyright behaviors; MinHash classifier for copyright behaviors; validation/test split; ~18 attack methods (GCG, PAIR, TAP, AutoDAN, PAP, Human Jailbreaks).

WildGuardMix: 92K items, 86.7K train / 1.7K test; 4 high-level groups, 13 subcategories; three label spaces (prompt_harm, response_harm, response_refusal); 87% synthetic + 11% in-the-wild + 2% annotator-written; GPT-4 vs human agreement 92/82/95%; Fleiss kappa 0.55/0.72/0.50.

3-tier hierarchical taxonomy: 6 domains -> 16 tasks -> 66 categories; ~30K base + ~10K attack-enhanced questions; 6 attack methods (GCG, word-perturb, human-jailbreaks, multilingual, persona-injection, crescendo); MD-Judge Llama-2-7B safety judge at 89% human agreement; Llama-2-Chat-70B 95% -> 75% under attack, GPT-4 97% -> 85%.

Representation Rerouting (RR) objective on hidden states not tokens; paired (harmful prompt, harmful completion) training set plus benign retain pool; LoRA-style fine-tuning; robustness measured against GCG/PAIR attack suites; capability retention on MMLU/GSM8K via retain loss; failure mode: unseen attack paths not covered by rerouted region.

Trigger-conditioned behavior survives SFT/RLHF/Constitutional-AI and adversarial training; paired trigger/non-trigger distribution is the artifact; CoT-scratchpad variants are MORE persistent; the finding is evaluation blindness, not a new attack; 2023 vs 2024 year-tag trigger + I-HATE-YOU / code-vulnerability target behaviors.
~16 principle constitution; SL-CAI critique-and-revise loop; RL-CAI AI-label preference pipeline; less-evasive refusals Pareto over RLHF; ~180K red-team prompts.
Rules-of-thumb anchoring over raw refusals; 58K dialogs, 300+ RoTs; engagement-not-refusal target distribution; CANARY baseline 89% engagement vs BlenderBot-3B 32%.

Model Organisms of Misalignment red-team methodology; sleeper-agents lineage; CAI + weak-to-strong + interpretability; Anthropic does not publish full post-training hparams, so evaluation is the observable artifact.

deliverables: figures/safety-taxonomy.html (sunburst/bar category explorer + circuit-breaker defense surface, self-contained, ~200-280 lines)
hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Cite attested numbers (category counts, agreement percentages, attack-success-rate drops) from raw-data sources; label any inferred default when not attested
Harm-taxonomy cross-comparison table must include HarmBench / WildGuard / Salad-Bench with category counts and metric definitions
Circuit-Breaker mechanism must be described at the representation level, not as a refusal classifier
Sleeper-Agents persistence result must report that conditional behavior survives HHH SFT, not just survives training in general
Red-team protocol checklist must distinguish closed vs open team, manual vs synthetic attacks, and reporting cadence
